title: Chuyển ví dụ Python sang cú pháp tường minh cho học viên mới

scope.work_style: ten sequential batches, up to five lessons per batch, independent commits, CI PASS, merge and durable ledger after each batch
rules: In all executable Python examples remove every `assert` used for checking/preconditions, replace with explicit `if` and a clear meaningful reaction such as a readable `raise ValueError`/`raise RuntimeError` or explicit output; preserve learning intent and avoid hiding failures.

Rewrite list/set/dict comprehensions and generator expressions (for example `[i for i, color in enumerate(colors, 1) if color == "Xanh"]`) as explicit initialization, `for` loops and nested `if` where necessary; prioritize beginners understanding over terse syntax.
Apply the same readability principle to other unnecessarily terse or nested one-liners only when they obscure beginner learning, keeping results equivalent.

Preserve lesson structure, definitions, scenarios, concepts and meaning, MCQ questions/answers, intentional algorithm choices, record counts 10/12/15/18/20 and exact documented stdout; do not change output silently.

For every batch verify independently executed code blocks still match stdout exactly; run existing curriculum structure/MCQ/Markdown regression and prior batch tests; record commits/PR/CI/merge; no fabricated Windows validation.
